svg.title: ok-FPGA-Server System Topology & Crate Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing Network Clients and Discovery on the left connecting via REST, gRPC, Web Dashboard, MQTT, and mDNS to the Rust ok-FPGA-Server workspace in the center (ok-fpga-server, ok-fpga-core with Resource Locks and User MMIO Stub Logic, ok-fpga-ffi), bridging via dynamic C API runtime loading into User-Supplied Opal Kelly IP over USB 3.0 / PCIe to Opal Kelly FPGA hardware on the right.
